editorial:
Malcolm and Kisha finally move into their dream home, but their fresh start quickly turns into a nightmare when a demon decides to move in too. This comedy horror spoof takes aim at all those found-footage and documentary style scary movies you have seen over the years, turning the usual creepy setup into a string of outrageous jokes. Malcolm is less worried about the haunting and more worried about keeping his sex life on track, which sets the tone for the whole movie. The humor is loud, silly, and unapologetic, leaning heavily on physical comedy and over-the-top reactions. If you enjoy parody films that poke fun at horror cliches, you will find plenty to laugh at here. Do not expect subtle scares; this one is all about ridiculous moments and goofy characters.

The cast commits fully to the absurdity, and the fast pacing keeps jokes coming without much downtime. Some jokes miss the mark and the humor can feel repetitive. It is not for everyone, but if you want a silly movie night with friends, this is a fun pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the demon fully takes over Kisha, and Malcolm's attempts to fix things only make everything worse. The priest, psychic, and ghost-busters all fail in hilarious ways. The twist comes when the chaos peaks and the found-footage style breaks down completely, revealing the whole ordeal as an over-the-top parody. The movie ends on a wild, ridiculous note with Malcolm facing the consequences of his choices, leaving you laughing at how absurd the whole haunting became.
